# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 - 2026-11-04

- First version in this marketplace: the Buildkite skills, copied from https://github.com/buildkite/skills at commit `d29b846`.
- Skill files are unchanged from the vendor's.
- The vendor's plugin-level files (`.claude-plugin/`, `.github/`, `README.md` and similar) are not included. BoldCreate Connect delivers only skills, agents, rules and hooks.
- The vendor's `mcp.json`, `scripts/` and `steering/` are not included.
